Let \(n\) be the number of clowns. Since each clown uses at least 5 colors, the total number of color-clown incidences is at least \(5n\). Since each of the 12 colors can be used by at most 20 clowns, the total number of incidences is at most \(12 \cdot 20 = 240\). Thus

\[
5n \le 240 \implies n \le 48.
\]

So \(n \le 48\).

Now show 48 is achievable. Label the colors \(0,1,\dots,11\). Take the four 5-sets:

\[
\{0,1,2,3,4\},\quad \{0,1,2,3,5\},\quad \{0,1,2,3,6\},\quad \{0,1,2,3,7\}.
\]

For each of these, take all 12 cyclic shifts modulo 12. This gives \(4 \cdot 12 = 48\) distinct 5-sets. In each orbit of 12 shifts, every color appears exactly 5 times, so across the 4 orbits every color appears exactly \(4 \cdot 5 = 20\) times.

Thus the maximum possible number of clowns is

\[
\boxed{48}.
\]
